title: Synthesis, biological activities and computational studies of bis-Schiff base derivatives of 4-hydroxyacetophenone: insights from an in vitro, molecular docking and dynamics simulation approach
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,21700-21714
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA01367D, Paper

Gul Badshah, Aftab Alam, Muhammad Ayaz, Ahmed A. Elhenawy, Imtiaz Ahmad, Shujaat Ahmad, Muhammad Usman, Ashwag S. Alanazi, Abdul Latif, Mumtaz Ali, Manzoor Ahmad
4-Hydroxyacetophenone derivatives were synthesized and characterized. These compounds exhibited promising cholinesterase inhibition, supported by docking and DFT studies that revealed strong binding interactions and favorable electronic properties.
